goalpostVerdict.detail: VERIFIED, not accepted. (1) report.equivalent's formula (diffs.length===0 && !vacuous) is BYTE-IDENTICAL to before this sprint — untouched — and the test asserts it FALSE directly, in the same test, immediately before checking the amended claim. The literal bar was never softened. (2) The allowlist has EXACTLY two members, Object.freeze'd, and the test HARDCODES expect(Object.keys(...).sort()).toEqual(['audits','pipelineResult']) — any future widening requires editing that literal inside a test, so it cannot happen invisibly in review. (3) Both mutation directions independently reproduced red, then reverted byte-identical. (4) The ORCHESTRATOR, not the generator, wrote the amendment into the contract BEFORE the sprint started, specifying this exact form and explicitly forbidding comparison-adjustment — the generator implemented a pre-specified amendment, not a self-serving relaxation. (5) Both allowlist reasons trace to specific source facts the evaluator checked itself, and audits is backed by an ADR written at sprint 3, independent of this sprint.
goalpostVerdict.disclosedLimitation: A test can enforce that the accepted set stays internally consistent and stays exactly two members; it CANNOT prove the underlying 'architectural' characterisation is correct. That remains a human/ADR judgement — the same limit sprint 3's precedent carries. The record discloses this candidly: pipelineResult.errors' formal ADR joinder is explicitly still RECOMMENDED and UNDECIDED, not silently treated as settled.
goalpostVerdict.whatGoalpostMovingWouldHaveLookedLike: Quietly merging the two into one settled claim, or weakening report.equivalent itself. This sprint did neither.

summary: All 6 criteria independently verified. The literal equivalent:false claim stays pinned and directly asserted; the allowlist is a separate, frozen, test-pinned two-member function whose membership matches source-grounded ADR reasoning; both mutation directions reproduce red. Full gate green on a clean worktree, and sprint 10's two evidence caveats survive unsoftened.
